name: Progressive Hierarchy with Multi-triangulation
aliases: Progressive Hierarchy with Multi-triangulation (Cignoni et al.)
definition: A dynamic Level-of-Detail (LOD) technique based on creating a progressive hierarchy of tetrahedra stored in a multi-triangulation data structure.
summary: Progressive Hierarchy with Multi-triangulation is a dynamic LOD technique for volume rendering that uses a multi-triangulation structure to encode simplification operations, enabling interactive frame rates by dynamically updating the mesh rather than relying on static levels of detail.
